frame: LVLH (x=radial, y=along-track, z=cross-track), chief at origin

label_criteria.post_burn_V_le_0: free drift from post-burn state reaches KOZ within 1800 s (V<=0)
label_criteria.passive_preburn_unsafe: free drift from pre-burn state reaches KOZ within 1800 s

note: At this start range (1.2 km) and horizon (1800 s), the minimum dv that reaches the KOZ is ~0.65 m/s (> the 0.5 cap), so every V<=0 plan also trips dv_cap; the criteria overlap by construction here.
